systems.system: Births and Deaths Registry IT system
systems.tiers: Planned as at April 2025: existing systems to be upgraded, all offices digitised and records made accessible across districts; the Registry's district offices have been ceded to the Local Government Service so that assemblies oversee the function

note: A national registry's plans for new regional offices and to digitise its offices (April 2025); a civil registration system and intentions only, with no connection at any assembly or district office stated.
